# Periwin Solutions

> Periwin Solutions is a software development and IT outsourcing company specializing in bridging UK startups with tech talent, heavily featuring a "hybrid-shore" model and leveraging talent in Nepal.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://periwin.com/): Main landing page.
- [About Us](https://periwin.com/about-us): Information about the company, its mission, and its team.
- [Contact Us](https://periwin.com/contact-us): Get in touch for IT outsourcing and software development inquiries.

## Our Services
Periwin Solutions offers a comprehensive suite of technical services:
- [IT Outsourcing](https://periwin.com/services/it-outsourcing)
- [Web Development](https://periwin.com/services/web-development)
- [Mobile Apps](https://periwin.com/services/mobile-apps)
- [Quality Assurance](https://periwin.com/services/quality-assurance)
- [Penetration Testing](https://periwin.com/services/penetration-testing)
